base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: the Tomkin-Mobile's luxurious leather cockpit, a dazzling dashboard of switches, dials and glowing screens, a precision-engineered cup-holder bay lined with a tiny cushion, back seats, and a windscreen. Lighting: glowing dashboard light, flickering exterior light.
In the shot: Tomkin, an anthropomorphic tabby cat who walks upright, slim and wiry, with burnt-orange "artisanal copper" fur and darker copper tiger stripes, bright emerald-green eyes, long expressive whiskers, a smug confident half-smile, brass welding goggles pushed up on his forehead, and a leather tool belt full of tiny gadgets; twelve small red squirrels with enormous bushy tails, wide anxious eyes, and the look of creatures absolutely ready to bite something.
Camera: Tomkin's eyes flick up to the ceiling.
Action: A tower of squirrels standing on each other's shoulders touches the hand-lacquered ceiling panel. Tomkin's eye twitches.
Dialogue: Tomkin (crisp, rapid-fire, precise male tenor with a clipped British accent; superior, exasperated, always certain he is the only rational being in the room, strained) says: "It is not fine, Marvel. That ceiling panel has four coats of marine-grade lacquer!"
Sound effects: tiny squeak on lacquer, ambience of purring engine, beeps and chimes.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
